description: This file defines utilities and classes for handling variable-length sequences in RNNs, including the PackedSequence class, and functions for packing and padding sequences.

classes.name: PackedSequence
classes.description: Class representing a packed sequence of variable length, used in RNN modules to handle sequences efficiently.

methods.name: PackedSequence::PackedSequence
methods.description: Constructor for the PackedSequence class, initializes with data, batch sizes, and optional sorted/unsorted indices.

methods.name: PackedSequence::data
methods.description: Returns the data tensor containing the packed sequence.

methods.name: PackedSequence::batch_sizes
methods.description: Returns the tensor of batch sizes at each sequence step.

methods.name: PackedSequence::sorted_indices
methods.description: Returns the tensor of sorted indices.

methods.name: PackedSequence::unsorted_indices
methods.description: Returns the tensor of unsorted indices.

methods.name: PackedSequence::pin_memory
methods.description: Returns a pinned memory copy of the packed sequence.

methods.name: PackedSequence::to
methods.description: Converts the packed sequence to a specified device and dtype.

methods.name: PackedSequence::cuda
methods.description: Returns a copy of the sequence on CUDA device.

methods.name: PackedSequence::cpu
methods.description: Returns a copy of the sequence on CPU.

methods.name: PackedSequence::is_cuda
methods.description: Checks if data is on CUDA.

methods.name: PackedSequence::is_pinned
methods.description: Checks if data is in pinned memory.
